title: Give recurring decisions a fast path

chapters.title: One ticket. Two ways to answer.
chapters.text: Here's a ticket we've seen before: I was charged twice. It needs billing. Do we need another model read?

chapters.title: Familiar request? Take the fast path.
chapters.text: The fast path learns that choice. Short-text CPU work takes about fifty microseconds, skipping the model read.

chapters.title: Something unfamiliar? Ask decisio.
chapters.text: A request that doesn't qualify goes to decisio. So the model stays available for the cases that need it.

chapters.title: Keep the policy. Send new facts.
chapters.text: Save your shared policy as context. Send just the facts that change. When needed, the model can still read both.

chapters.title: Teach. Check. Then switch it on.
chapters.text: Teach with examples. Check separate examples and time savings. If it qualifies, switch the fast path on.
